## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.14] - 2026-11-22

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.13...v2.0.0-alpha.14](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.13...v2.0.0-alpha.14)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 上下文计数维护更新，修复可见 reasoning 在共享估算中被遗漏的问题。

**缺陷修复**

- 将当前请求中保留的 reasoning 纳入共享上下文估算，避免缺少 provider usage 时低估占用；请求时已移除的 reasoning 不再计入。
- 解压预算投影复用共享计数，移除独立累加，避免 reasoning 被重复计算；保持原有文本与工具内容的合并计数方式。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不新增配置项或依赖，不改变持久化格式、message refs 或 compression block IDs；从 alpha.13 升级无需数据迁移。
- 含可见 reasoning 的请求可能更早触发已有上下文提示或预算保护；不改变 reasoning 移除规则或历史 provider usage 的处理方式。

**已知问题**

- 上下文估算仍不包含原生媒体的实际成本，也不等同于 provider 的精确请求预算。本版不代表 [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51) 的全部问题均已解决。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.14] - 2026-11-22

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.13...v2.0.0-alpha.14](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.13...v2.0.0-alpha.14)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha context-accounting maintenance update fixing visible reasoning omitted from shared estimates.

**Fixes**

- Include reasoning retained in the current request in shared context estimates, avoiding undercounting when provider usage is unavailable. Reasoning removed at request time is no longer counted.
- Reuse shared accounting in decompression projections, removing the separate addition to avoid counting reasoning twice while preserving existing text/tool batching.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No new configuration options or dependencies, and no changes to persisted formats, message refs, or compression block IDs. Upgrading from alpha.13 requires no data migration.
- Requests containing visible reasoning may trigger existing context notices or budget protection earlier. Reasoning-removal rules and historical provider usage handling are unchanged.

**Known issues**

- Context estimates still exclude actual native media costs and are not exact provider request budgets. This release does not resolve every issue tracked in [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51).

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.13] - 2026-11-22

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.12...v2.0.0-alpha.13](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.12...v2.0.0-alpha.13)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 上下文安全维护更新，完善解压预算预检、近期消息压缩及紧急裁剪保护。

**缺陷修复**

- 解压前按实际可见消息投影估算文本与 reasoning 占用，并预留 completion 预算。预计增长且超出输入预算时，保持压缩状态与统计不变，提供可执行的 `toFile` 调用，引导关键词搜索与分段读取；不会自动写文件。
- 修复 `dangerous: true` 未绕过近期消息软保护的问题；工具／文件、最后用户消息、smart-plan 和质量检查仍然有效。
- 紧急裁剪跳过命中工具或文件保护规则的整条消息；sticky replay 不再将旧截断结果覆盖到当前受保护消息上。
- 紧急裁剪与 sticky replay 使用同一份 provider/model 生效配置，正确应用模型专属保护设置。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不新增配置项或依赖，不改变持久化格式、message refs 或 compression block IDs；从 alpha.12 升级无需数据迁移。
- `emergencyTruncation` 默认仍关闭；现有截断记录保留，取消保护后可继续按原有逻辑重放。

**已知问题**

- 解压预算为可见文本与 reasoning 的估算，不包含原生媒体的实际 token 成本，也不等同于 provider 的精确请求预算。
- 受保护内容可能使请求仍然超预算；保护规则不会恢复被宿主原生 compaction 或外部操作清除的内容。本版不代表 [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51) 的全部问题均已解决。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.13] - 2026-11-22

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.12...v2.0.0-alpha.13](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.12...v2.0.0-alpha.13)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha context-safety maintenance update improving decompression preflight, recent-message compression, and emergency truncation protection.

**Fixes**

- Estimate visible text and reasoning before decompression, reserving room for completion. When restoration would grow context beyond the input budget, leave compression state and statistics unchanged and provide an executable `toFile` call with guidance for keyword searches and partial reads. No file is written automatically.
- Fix `dangerous: true` failing to bypass recent-message soft protection. Tool/file, last-user-message, smart-plan, and quality checks still apply.
- Skip entire messages matching protected tool or file rules during emergency truncation. Sticky replay no longer overwrites currently protected messages with previously truncated output.
- Use the same effective provider/model configuration for emergency truncation and sticky replay, including model-specific protection settings.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No new configuration options or dependencies, and no changes to persisted formats, message refs, or compression block IDs. Upgrading from alpha.12 requires no data migration.
- `emergencyTruncation` remains disabled by default. Existing frozen truncation entries are retained and can resume replay under the existing rules when protection is removed.

**Known issues**

- Decompression budgeting estimates visible text and reasoning; it excludes actual native media token costs and is not an exact provider request budget.
- Protected content may leave a request over budget. Protection does not restore content removed by native host compaction or external operations. This release does not resolve every issue tracked in [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51).

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.12] - 2026-11-21

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.11...v2.0.0-alpha.12](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.11...v2.0.0-alpha.12)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 媒体维护更新，修复 V2 上下文转换中的用户附件丢失与工具媒体 base64 文本化问题。

**缺陷修复**

- 保留宿主已处理的用户附件文本及原生媒体对象，避免图片和文件在上下文转换后丢失，同时保留宿主的附件去重与顺序。
- 将工具返回的文件保留为结构化媒体，不再把文件对象及其 base64 内容序列化为普通文本；保留已有文本裁剪和工具调用配对行为，不恢复已清除的工具输出。
- 将工具返回的受支持内联图片纳入现有图片归档，在压缩摘要中保留可重新读取的文件指针。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不新增配置项或依赖，不改变持久化格式、message refs 或 compression block IDs；从 alpha.11 升级无需数据迁移。
- 图片归档继续受现有 `compress.images` 配置控制，不下载远程图片，也不归档 PDF 或 SVG。

**已知问题**

- 恢复媒体传递不代表媒体输入不占用上下文或费用；实际媒体处理仍取决于所用模型及 provider。
- 本版不包含解压预算检查修复，也不消除全部长历史扫描与等待；[#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51) 的其余问题继续分步处理。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.12] - 2026-11-21

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.11...v2.0.0-alpha.12](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.11...v2.0.0-alpha.12)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha media maintenance update fixing lost user attachments and tool media serialized as base64 text during V2 context transforms.

**Fixes**

- Preserve the host's projected user attachment text and native media objects, preventing images and files from being lost during context transforms while retaining attachment deduplication and ordering.
- Keep tool-returned files as structured media instead of serializing file objects and their base64 payloads as plain text. Preserve existing text trimming and tool-call pairing without restoring cleared tool output.
- Include supported inline images returned by tools in the existing image archive, retaining re-readable file pointers in compression summaries.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No new configuration options or dependencies, and no changes to persisted formats, message refs, or compression block IDs. Upgrading from alpha.11 requires no data migration.
- Image archiving remains controlled by the existing `compress.images` settings. Remote images are not downloaded, and PDFs and SVGs are not archived.

**Known issues**

- Restoring media delivery does not eliminate its context usage or cost. Actual media handling still depends on the selected model and provider.
- This release does not include decompression-budget fixes or eliminate all long-history scanning and delays. Remaining issues in [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51) will continue to be addressed separately.

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.11] - 2026-11-21

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.10...v2.0.0-alpha.11](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.10...v2.0.0-alpha.11)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 文件保护维护更新，修复配置 `protectedFilePatterns` 后对 V2 文件工具参数识别不完整的问题。

**缺陷修复**

- 识别文件工具的 `path` 参数，保留已有 `filePath` 和 `multiedit` 路径提取行为，使匹配文件参与现有压缩过滤、范围保护提示和工具输出保留。
- 识别 `patch.patchText`，保留 `apply_patch` 支持；新增、修改、删除及重命名目标路径均参与保护判断，重命名源路径同样保留。
- 避免将补丁新增正文中的类似操作头文本误判为文件路径。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不新增配置项或依赖，不改变 glob 匹配规则、持久化格式、message refs 或 compression block IDs；从 alpha.10 升级无需数据迁移。
- 文件保护仍需配置匹配的 `protectedFilePatterns`，不会默认启用，也不会自动恢复已经压缩的消息。此前漏判的匹配消息升级后可能不再进入可压缩范围。

**已知问题**

- 本版仅修复公共路径提取，不改变 OpenCode 原生 compaction 或其他压缩器的行为。
- 本版不包含 [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51) 中的图片/base64、解压预算修复，也不消除全部长历史扫描与等待。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.11] - 2026-11-21

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.10...v2.0.0-alpha.11](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.10...v2.0.0-alpha.11)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha file-protection maintenance update fixing incomplete recognition of V2 file-tool parameters when `protectedFilePatterns` is configured.

**Fixes**

- Recognize file tools’ `path` parameter while retaining existing `filePath` and `multiedit` extraction, so matching files participate in existing compression filtering, protected-range guidance, and tool-output preservation.
- Recognize `patch.patchText` while retaining `apply_patch` support. Include added, updated, deleted, and move-destination paths in protection checks, alongside move-source paths.
- Avoid interpreting operation-header-like text in added patch content as file paths.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No new configuration options or dependencies, and no changes to glob matching rules, persisted formats, message refs, or compression block IDs. Upgrading from alpha.10 requires no data migration.
- File protection still requires matching `protectedFilePatterns`; it is not enabled by default and does not automatically restore already-compressed messages. Previously missed matching messages may no longer enter compressible ranges after upgrading.

**Known issues**

- This release only fixes shared path extraction. It does not change OpenCode native compaction or other compressors.
- This release does not include the image/base64 or decompression-budget fixes discussed in [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51), nor eliminate all long-history scanning or delays.

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.10] - 2026-11-20

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.9...v2.0.0-alpha.10](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.9...v2.0.0-alpha.10)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 性能维护更新，减少长历史的重复 token 编码及工具事件中的完整历史读取。

**功能优化**

- 为精确 token 计数增加最多 65,536 条的进程内 LRU 缓存，仅保留内容指纹和计数，不保留原文。内容改变后重新计算，失败后的近似估算不进入缓存。
- 优先从工具生命周期事件获取工具名，正常事件序列无需为此读取完整历史；缺失事件或缓存淘汰时保留历史查询及重试，压缩计时行为保持不变。
- 扩展现有请求级诊断，记录计数路径、缓存命中、未命中、淘汰、错误及耗时；离线汇总兼容旧记录，不记录输入文本或指纹。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不增加配置项或依赖，不改变持久化格式、message refs 或 compression block IDs；从 alpha.9 升级无需数据迁移。
- 保留既有文本归一化、特殊 token、失败回退及历史 provider usage 处理方式。

**已知问题**

- 缓存命中仍需扫描文本生成指纹，首次或淘汰后的内容仍需编码；并发会话总工作集超过容量时仍可能反复淘汰，不保证冷路径加速。
- 本版不消除其他历史加载或全部长历史等待，也不包含 [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51) 中的图片/base64 问题及解压预算修复。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.10] - 2026-11-20

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.9...v2.0.0-alpha.10](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.9...v2.0.0-alpha.10)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha performance maintenance update reducing repeated token encoding for long histories and full-history reads during tool events.

**Improvements**

- Add a process-local LRU cache with up to 65,536 exact token counts, retaining only content fingerprints and counts, not original text. Changed content is recounted, and approximate fallback results are not cached.
- Resolve tool names from lifecycle events, avoiding full-history reads for this purpose during normal event sequences. Preserve history lookup and retries for missing events or evicted entries, without changing compression timing.
- Extend existing request-local diagnostics with counting paths, cache hits, misses, evictions, errors, and elapsed time. Offline summaries remain compatible with older records; input text and fingerprints are not logged.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No new configuration options or dependencies, and no changes to persisted formats, message refs, or compression block IDs. Upgrading from alpha.9 requires no data migration.
- Preserve existing text normalization, special-token handling, failure fallback, and historical provider usage handling.

**Known issues**

- Cache hits still scan text to compute fingerprints; first-seen or evicted content still requires encoding. Concurrent sessions whose combined working set exceeds capacity may still cause repeated eviction. Cold-path speedups are not guaranteed.
- This release does not eliminate other history loading or all long-history delays, and does not include the image/base64 or decompression-budget fixes discussed in [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51).
